description: This file contains unit tests for the installation manager component of the starboard loader application, including setup, reset, rollforward, revert, and boundary condition tests, utilizing Google Test framework.

classes.name: InstallationManagerTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the installation manager, with setup and teardown methods, and helper functions for testing rollforward and revert logic.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including obtaining storage path and setting up installation store path.

methods.name: SaveStorageState
methods.description: Serializes and saves the installation store state to a file.

methods.name: ReadStorageState
methods.description: Reads and parses the installation store state from a file.

methods.name: RollForwardHelper
methods.description: Helper to test rollforward logic by setting up installation states, performing rollforward, and verifying priorities.

methods.name: RevertHelper
methods.description: Helper to test revert logic by setting up installation states, attempting revert, and verifying priorities and success.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment, removing created files and directories.
